purpose: Bootstrap gold set for call topics extraction pipeline evaluation. Layer 1 of the gold set (3 transcripts covering 3 distinct call types). Used to evaluate pipeline against ground truth for topic recall, citation validity, and naming stability.
annotation_notes: Topics in this gold set reflect ONLY what is grounded in each transcript. Topics from the user's working tracker that come from manual augmentation, cross-call synthesis, or external sources are explicitly excluded — the pipeline must not invent topics that are not in the transcript it is processing.

Citations are line ranges into the numbered transcript files (arm_kickoff_05112026_numbered.txt, snowflake_kickoff_numbered.txt, factset_05182026_numbered.txt). Pipeline output must resolve these line ranges to byte-identical transcript text.
Owner field is best-effort and non-blocking for pipeline evaluation. Pipeline failures on owner attribution do not fail the gold set evaluation.
Importance levels are subjective but reflect the user's operational priorities.

topic_recall.definition: Fraction of expected_topics that appear in pipeline output (matched by canonical name or close semantic match)

topic_precision.definition: Fraction of pipeline-output topics that match an expected_topic (or are reasonable but absent from gold set)
topic_precision.note: Topics in topics_explicitly_excluded count as false positives if extracted by the pipeline.

task_recall.definition: For each correctly-matched topic, fraction of expected_tasks that are represented in pipeline output (matched by must_have_keywords)

citation_validity.definition: Fraction of citations in pipeline output that match transcript text byte-for-byte
citation_validity.note: Failure here indicates the span-based citation resolution (Stage 4) is broken.

citation_coverage.definition: For each topic, citations cover the expected evidence_line_ranges (any overlap counts)

naming_stability.definition: Across 5 re-runs of the same transcript, same topics get same canonical names

no_hallucination.definition: Topics in topics_explicitly_excluded must NOT appear in pipeline output
